summary: Digital Brands Group, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 9, 2026, announcing a strategic partnership between its AVO brand and the largest U.S. college bookstore chain, taking over lululemon's retail space in over 1,000 locations. It also issued Q3 2026 revenue guidance of $8.5M-$11.0M, projecting 300%-500% year-over-year growth and positive net income, driven by collegiate expansion and a government contract. This filing reports routine operational and financial updates, not a special situation.
